Message:
With that same smile
plastered on her face,
Elaine plunged her hand deep
within her own body.

Her fingers wriggled around,
as if searching for something.
I couldn’t even finish my sentence.

It wasn’t just the act itself
that terrified me, but the way
she treated her own body
like some kind of object.

My voice caught in my throat,
unable to make a sound.

Eventually, she pulled out
something, glowing and radiant,
like nothing I’d ever seen before.

“I can touch
and manipulate spirits.
With this power,
I can save him.”

“What are you saying?!
What good can come from that?
We’re not dolls you can just
toy with as you please!”

No matter how much
I shouted and pleaded,
Elaine just stood there, smiling.
This wasn’t the Elaine I know.

The kind girl who once
scolded me for putting others
before myself would never say
something like this.

If this was the work of a demon,
there was only one thing
left for me to do...

“Elaine...I have one last
favor to ask of you.”
